findings.confirmed_by: direct read (main evaluator) + independent subagent audit
findings.title: Stale Opus+Sonnet verification-topology tables contradict the single-current-session-model SSOT (the exact panel AC-2 names for replacement still lives)
evidence: skills/claude/kiwi-srs/SKILL.md §10.3 L646: output schema still enumerates evaluator: 'opus-A|sonnet-B|opus-C'; §10.4 'toplogy' table L642-645: Normal = Opus|Sonnet|-, --max = Opus|Sonnet|Opus (= exactly the Opus x1+Sonnet x1 / Opus x2+Sonnet x1 panel AC-2 says to replace). Contradicts §0.20 L37 (declared SSOT: single subagent, current session model, 'replaces the former Opus x1+Sonnet x1 panel'), description L3, Phase-flow L204, and §10.2 L601 ('the verification subagent ... Max 2nd pass').

skills/claude/kiwi-srs-feasibility/SKILL.md §8.4 L640-645: verbatim clone of the same table (Normal Opus|Sonnet, --max Opus|Sonnet|Opus); L636 even states 'same structure as kiwi-srs §10.3'. Contradicts its own §0.15 single-current-session clause.
findings.why_gap: §0.20 explicitly scopes its change to the 'verification-subagent composition' (leaving everything else unchanged). That composition IS precisely what §10.3/§10.4 (and §8.4) define, yet those tables were never updated and carry no read-time-replace pointer to §0.20 (unlike the explicit read-time-replace pattern used in auto-option.md). An agent reaching §10.4 would spawn Opus+Sonnet, violating FR-FLOW-022 AC-2's single-current-session intent. Sibling skills (kiwi-planner, kiwi-coder, kiwi-srs-sync) were converted cleanly with no live Opus+Sonnet evaluator table, confirming these are genuine leftovers, not intentional.
findings.suggested_fix: Update §10.3 evaluator enum + §10.4 topology (and feasibility §8.4) to declare a single verification subagent on the current session model (Max = + independent 2nd pass), or add an explicit 'overridden by §0.20 at read time' pointer, matching the clean pattern already used in kiwi-planner.

findings.title: kiwi-srs-from-code 4-axis verifier hardcodes verifier models (Sonnet 1st / Opus escalation) instead of the current session model
evidence: skills/claude/kiwi-srs-from-code/SKILL.md §8.1 L384-391: the 4-axis verification panel pins models - Missing-Detector & Correctness-Auditor 'Sonnet (1st) / Opus (escalation)', Hallucination-Hunter & Scope-Creep-Reviewer 'Sonnet / Sonnet' (L391 cost guardrail escalates to Opus). This is a model-hardcoded verification panel contradicting the skill's §0 single-current-session-model claim for its Phase-4 verifiers.
findings.why_gap: Different shape from the Opus+Sonnet 2-panel, but still a model-hardcoded verification panel that FR-FLOW-022 'verification performed by a single subagent inheriting the current session model' would govern.
findings.suggested_fix: Rebind the 4 verifier axes to the current session model (with --model override), moving the Sonnet->Opus escalation into an iteration policy rather than a hardcoded model assignment, or document it as an explicit exception.

findings.title: kiwi-review-fix-loop and kiwi-hot-fix default the verification/reviewer role model to Opus rather than the current session model (secondary, role-labeled)
evidence: skills/claude/kiwi-review-fix-loop/SKILL.md §1.3 L178-181: mode matrix pins '까칠 리뷰어' (picky reviewer = the quality-gate evaluator) to Opus x1 (Normal) / Opus x2 (--max) and '정형 검사' to Sonnet; the '--model <name>' rows (L182-183) do honor override (AC-3 OK) but the DEFAULT is Opus, not the current session model.
skills/claude/kiwi-hot-fix/SKILL.md §1.3 L126-129: same pattern (까칠 리뷰어 Opus x1/x2, 정형 검사 Sonnet).
findings.why_gap: These skills use a reviewer/fixer pipeline (a different architecture from the 'dual-model evaluator panel' AC-2 literally names). Whether the code-review 까칠 리뷰어 counts as FR-FLOW-022 'verification/evaluation' is interpretation-dependent; if it does, defaulting it to Opus (not current session model) violates AC-2's default clause. Lower confidence / lower severity than QA-301/302.
findings.suggested_fix: If in scope, change the 까칠 리뷰어 / 정형 검사 default from Opus/Sonnet to the current session model (keeping --model override and count escalation); otherwise add a scoping note that these reviewer roles are exempt from FR-FLOW-022.

overall: Round-3 focus (FR-FLOW-025 committee) is CLEAN and full-match: the QB-201 fix made the auto-option.md §2 mode table consistent with the §3 escalation ladder (3->5 escalate; non-unanimous 5 plurality; --max 5->7 plurality; lead-member #1 tie-break), and the QB-202 fix (merged_decision field) is consistent across all 3 variants with zero applied_decision residuals. FR-FLOW-023/024/026/027/028/029/030/031/032 are all full-match. The single gap is FR-FLOW-022 AC-2, which is PRE-EXISTING and orthogonal to the round-3 fixes: the very Opus+Sonnet dual-model evaluator panel AC-2 names for replacement still lives as a live topology/output table in kiwi-srs (§10.3/§10.4) and its verbatim clone in kiwi-srs-feasibility (§8.4), and kiwi-srs-from-code (§8.1) still hardcodes its 4-axis verifier models - each contradicting its own §0 single-current-session-model SSOT clause (QA-301/302); review-fix-loop/hot-fix §1.3 default their reviewer role to Opus (QA-303, secondary/interpretation-dependent). Fix is documentation-internal consistency: update the stale tables to single-current-session-model, mirroring the clean pattern already implemented in kiwi-planner/kiwi-coder/kiwi-srs-sync.
